text: One reviewer describes CitriSafe Remedy Laundry Liquid Detergent as "free of scents" [S2], while another notes that it left their clothes smelling clean [S3]. Another user mentions that they are sensitive to smells and essential oils, yet they tolerate this product very well [S3]. The provided sources do not explicitly state whether the product is officially fragrance-free by manufacturer definition, only that a reviewer found it free of scents [S2].
